candidate_limits.status: diagnostic only: not an acceptance bound with differing models

comparison_conventions.apparent: geocentric ICRF airless apparent RA/Dec at TT JD; compare Aria frame=icrs longitude/latitude to Horizons quantity 45
comparison_conventions.geometric: geocentric ICRF vector at TDB JD; Aria centre minus Earth, km and km/s
comparison_conventions.model_differences: Horizons dynamically selects its own source kernels, not the Aria DE442s-plus-offset stack; differences are unresolved diagnostics
comparison_conventions.right_ascension_warning: Aria BodyPosition.right_ascension_deg is true-of-date; do not compare directly to Horizons inertial quantity 45

failure_policy: Source integrity, matching times/frames, target identity, finite results and all 300 records are mandatory; observed model-dependent residuals are retained, never adjusted to manufacture a pass
